verdict.rationale: Publishing paper, fax, or mail fallback channels with exact addresses, numbers, and forms is a fair axis for a state tax agency, so the story applies. The pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 denials at the front door (www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt) and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host. Neither says anything about a published paper, fax, or mail rail, so there is no evidence of the capability. Confidence is low because the gap reflects blocked access rather than a documented absence.
